name: Midas Capital fsAMM-HAY-BUSD cToken rounding loss
summary: Midas CToken.redeemFresh converted an exact requested underlying amount to the cTokens to burn with divScalarByExpTruncate, rounding the burn down. After reducing the fsAMM-HAY-BUSD market to 1,001 wei of cToken supply and donating underlying to inflate its exchange rate, the attacker repeatedly requested about 1.998 wei of underlying while burning only 1 wei; the remaining-supply guard did not activate because each redemption left exactly 1,000 wei. The inflated collateral position was then used to borrow and liquidate cash from three other Midas markets.
notes: The market's sixth and last NewImplementation(address,address) event before the incident changed CDelegationStorage slot 0 from 0x1d48efba40d11c22315dd278e69268bca9dd5d7d to 0xf3c870b7c201515e2552d018ec2a15910fd35909. Slot 0 retains 0xf3c870b7c201515e2552d018ec2a15910fd35909 immediately before the anchor, and the anchor trace shows the market delegate-calling that artifact for the vulnerable redeemUnderlying and redeem paths.

Gross loss is the exact pre-recovery depletion of external token balances in the three victim debt markets over the 17 value-bearing campaign transactions: fANKR 0x13ae975c5a1198e4f47c68c31c1230694dc44a57 lost 685999.702783572563751254 ANKR, fankrBNB 0xb2b01d6f953a28ba6c8f9e22986f5bddb7653aea lost 1148.264532617591819152 ankrBNB, and fHAY 0x10b6f851225c203ee74c369ce876beb56379fca3 lost 25296.116863562095022654 HAY. This excludes the attacker's flash liquidity and donated fsAMM-HAY-BUSD collateral rather than treating those circular inputs as victim loss. It also excludes later swaps and proceeds handling, and nets no recovery. The project post-mortem's approximately USD 340,000 pool-drain estimate corroborates this USD 332,253.20 component valuation; the seed row's USD 600,000 figure described attacker proceeds/profit and is not a comparable victim-depletion measure.
